title: Sam and the Mat
lines: Pam and Sam tap the mat.

questions.ask: Who sat at the mat first?
questions.listenFor: Sam. It is the very first line — point at it rather than telling them.

questions.ask: Who taps the mat at the end?
questions.listenFor: Pam and Sam, together. The last line says so.

questions.ask: What sound does the mat make? Show me.
questions.listenFor: No right answer. Let them tap the table and make the sound themselves.
